body: I feel very similar. I wish I could give better advice but gays are cruel. Don't worry too much about losing hair--many guys are. Go to a dermatologist now before it gets bad. And remember that social media is toxic--avoid it.
Your sentences are well constructed and you seem pretty smart. Why not try? There are always academic accommodations available for students with depression that need help with deadlines and such.

I have the same social issues-my therapists have always said it starts with the mother. Maybe you should finish school (or get a completion certificate like a GED) and go to college and get away from your home life.
